stem: Besides high blood pressure, amlodipine is used to treat which of the following cardiac conditions?

options.label: A
options.misconception: Confuses dihydropyridines like amlodipine with verapamil and diltiazem, which slow AV conduction.
options.explanation: Rate control in atrial fibrillation or flutter uses beta-blockers or non-dihydropyridine calcium channel blockers; amlodipine has little AV nodal effect.

options.label: B
options.text: Complete heart block and sinus bradycardia
options.misconception: Assumes any cardiac drug can treat any rhythm disturbance, including slow rhythms.
options.explanation: Heart block and bradycardia need atropine or pacing; amlodipine does not improve sinus node or AV nodal conduction.

options.label: C
options.misconception: Assumes amlodipine relieves any cause of chest pain, including pericardial inflammation.
options.explanation: Pericarditis is treated with NSAIDs and colchicine, with drainage mainly for tamponade; amlodipine has no role in either.

options.label: D
options.misconception: Treats amlodipine as a general cardiac drug rather than a vasodilator for pressure and angina.
options.explanation: Endocarditis needs prolonged antibiotics and rheumatic carditis needs anti-inflammatory therapy; amlodipine treats neither.

options.label: E
options.misconception: None — amlodipine treats hypertension, angina and coronary artery disease.
options.explanation: MedlinePlus lists high blood pressure, certain types of angina and coronary artery disease as the conditions amlodipine is used to treat.

context: Learning objective: Amlodipine is used to treat high blood pressure, certain types of angina and coronary artery disease.
